authorized_scope: WP13 only; execution and evidence preparation, not Owner score award, ledger mutation, merge, or push
execution_binding: Run only from the commit that adds this frozen contract; record that exact commit as EXECUTION_SHA before execution and in all result summaries.

scope.api: Verify the existing public qf_solver facade, documented stability classification, critical signatures, compatibility imports, minimal workflow, and documented input/serialization rejection behavior.
scope.diagnostics: Verify the existing summary/diagnostic/values audit levels, preservation of WARNING/FAIL rows, Markdown pass-row limiting, and configurable large-values warning behavior.
scope.performance: Run the existing bounded J2 nonlinear performance characterization once for its declared TET4 and TET10 cases; record runtime/resource/solver observables as measurements only.

commands.bounded_performance_campaign: python -c "from solveur.verification.j2_performance import J2NonlinearPerformanceCampaign; result = J2NonlinearPerformanceCampaign(r'qualification/0_2_9/wp13_wp14_overnight/wp13_performance').run(); print(result['status'])"

gates.api: The targeted public API contract test module exits 0; its checked-in exact export/signature/compatibility/workflow/rejection assertions remain unchanged.
gates.diagnostics: The targeted audit-detail test module exits 0; checked-in expectations for summary/diagnostic/values and WARNING/FAIL retention remain unchanged.
gates.campaign_harness: The targeted nonlinear performance harness test exits 0; no code or solver thresholds are altered.
gates.bounded_performance_cases: The existing campaign returns PASS_INTERNAL for exactly TET4 and TET10, with finite positive elapsed times, finite memory counts, finite residual metrics, and its existing per-case status PASS. Existing campaign-internal numerical checks are authoritative and unchanged.
gates.performance_thresholds: No elapsed-time, memory, speedup, scaling, or cross-machine threshold is defined by this contract. Timing and memory are observational only.
gates.evidence_integrity: Record execution SHA, contract SHA-256, policy digest, exact commands, runtime/machine metadata, output paths, and SHA-256 hashes. Preserve raw campaign outputs; do not overwrite prior evidence.

failure_cases: Public API test failure or changed documented export/signature is a WP13 FAIL; preserve test output.
Diagnostic test failure or suppression of WARNING/FAIL evidence is a WP13 FAIL; preserve test output.

Missing Gmsh/runtime dependency, campaign exception, non-PASS_INTERNAL campaign status, missing family, non-finite result, or missing evidence is FAIL_CLOSED; do not substitute another model or relax an assertion.
Any source/policy/contract digest mismatch or dirty execution checkout is FAIL_CLOSED before running.
limitations: The bounded performance campaign is not a performance benchmark suitable for cross-machine ranking or a scaling claim.
Coverage is limited to the existing small cyclic J2 TET4/TET10 campaign and tested API/audit contracts.
This does not qualify all solver methods, element families, large models, parallel execution, or production use.
The current progress ledger assigns WP13 one point while the frozen roadmap assigns two; this campaign will not resolve that allocation discrepancy or award points.
